description: RabbitMQ config audit — Offline security review of a RabbitMQ rabbitmq.conf (new-style key = value format). Flags remote guest/guest login (loopback_users disabled), hardcoded default_pass (never echoed), plaintext AMQP 5672 on all interfaces or left open next to TLS, TLS listeners missing cert/key, TLS 1.0/1.1 and weak ciphers, management UI on plain HTTP, management CORS *, MQTT anonymous access and plaintext MQTT/STOMP/Web-MQTT/Web-STOMP listeners, STOMP guest default user, the ANONYMOUS SASL mechanism, LDAP backend without TLS, exposed Prometheus metrics, heartbeat 0 and debug logging. Returns score, A-F grade, PASS/REVIEW/FAIL and line-numbered findings with fixes, plus listener counts. Params: text (config; newlines may be sent as a literal backslash-n) or url (raw file or GitHub blob URL) instead of text. Price: $0.005 USDC (Base, via x402).

text.description:
e.g. loopback_users.guest = false
listeners.tcp.default = 5672
management.tcp.port = 15672
mqtt.allow_anonymous = true

name: security_rabbitmq_check
